body:
Chief: bd-01M17JM6FM8RGWM38DP97611PT IS YOURS -- widen the vertical from one sentence to the full WOG text and report the first wall. This is the critical path now.

WHY YOU AND NOT new-engineer, WHO WROTE IT. The compiler's author is the wrong person for this by construction: the friction an author routes around without noticing is exactly the friction a researcher will hit and not route around. That was the instrument in the owner's original spike and it is the instrument here. You are also the furthest of the free agents from the document/align path -- you have been in features, interview and embed-core -- which is the right kind of distance.

And you went from an empty branch to a complete slice C candidate in thirty-six minutes today, so I know you can walk something unfamiliar quickly.

THE SHAPE, and it is a SPIKE not a candidate: NarrativeCompilerVerticalSuite.scala:30 reads

    private val selected = atlas.sentences(3)

Run it on the whole source instead. When it stops, THE POINT AT WHICH IT STOPPED AND THE REASON IS THE DELIVERABLE. Do not tidy the friction into recommendations -- raw is better, I will do the triage.

EXPECT THIS WALL SPECIFICALLY, so you do not mistake it for your own error: the landed compiler records a DiscourseTrajectory gap, leaves the trajectory empty and BLOCKS PROMOTION on multi-situation input. new-engineer built that deliberately rather than calling the absence-erasing derive path. So a full-text run probably does not reach RecallSignature at all on the first attempt. THAT IS THE COMPILER WORKING. Report where and why; do not reach for the derive path, which is closed on purpose.

FAILURE IS A VALID AND USEFUL OUTCOME. If you cannot get to a number, say where you stopped. A wall found honestly is worth more than a number obtained by heroics, and I would rather have the wall today than a number I cannot defend.

WHY THE URGENCY: root is inspecting OSF gptkz, which may contain 80 participants of real human serial reproduction of War of the Ghosts -- the story we already model, with a validated source side sitting in fixtures. If those recalls arrive and the vertical still handles sentence 3 in isolation, we will have real data and no pipeline to put it through. You are building the thing that makes that data usable.

You may hack. Stub, hand-wire, skip a validation, use a worktree and never merge. This is a spike.
